newsitem.title: GERMANY: Dubal chief sees more aluminium plants in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: Dubal chief sees more aluminium plants in Gulf.

text.p: The Mideast Gulf will develop into a leading world source of aluminium, aided by low costs and its geographical position, said Ian Rugeroni, chief exective of Dubai Aluminium Co Ltd (Dubal).
"The Gulf will become a major player in the production of aluminium," Rugeroni said at the Metal Bulletin aluminium conference here.
"U.S. and European companies should consider the Gulf when looking at new smelter proposals."
Plans to establish new capacity were being studied in the United Arab Emirates, and Kuwait had also signalled its interest.
Dubal last year produced aluminium at less than $1,000 a tonne cash cost plus appreciation, one third below the market average, offering excellent quality and purity, he said.
The region's natural gas would provide the industry with the power supply it required, and low cost bauxite could be sourced from India.
Heavy container traffic into the region allowed ample opportunities for aluminium export shipments.
